messages:
maria: quick note from a docs sweep: we have mixed usagein examples — 'model', 'model version', and 'variant' show up in different places. it's confusing for readers. proposal: standardize on 'model variant' in prose, keep SDK param as 'model'. thoughts?
devlin: agree on 'model variant' for prose. helps separate the runtime concept from semantic versions. also add a glossary alias so searches surface either term.
kai: pinging infra ppl: API payloads use 'model_version' in the REST spec. we shouldn't imply a field rename in docs. instead we could add a short mapping note: 'model variant (API: model_version)'.
maria: yes — document mapping and add a short migration snippet for SDKs and API clients. example in snippets section showing both forms.
tess: sample snippet idea:
```python
# prefer prose: 'model variant'
client.generate(model="redwood-7b-v2")  # 'model' param selects the model variant
# API JSON example
{
  "model_version": "redwood-7b-v2",
  "input": "Hello"
}
```
devlin: small voice note: avoid 'simply' & 'just' in explanatory sentences. prefer explicit action verbs. also favour short active sentences in examples.
maria: i'll open a tiny PR with: 1) glossary entry linking terms, 2) update to 8 example snippets, 3) API reference note, 4) brief migration note. aiming to keep changes minimal and non-breaking.
deploy-bot: PR created by maria: docs#912 (draft)
maria: assigning @devlin @kai for review. can we also get a quick grep from SDK owners for occurrences of 'model version' in code samples?
kai: will run repo search and paste results in PR comments. looks like ~9 hits in SDK readmes.
devlin: will do a tone pass too. also add one-line changelog entry under docs updates so customers see the wording guidance.
maria: timeline: draft PR by EOD today, reviews tomorrow morning. if any blockers, flag here.
tess: tiny nit: in headings prefer Title Case for guides but sentence case in inline prose (we should be consistent). don't change now unless part of larger pass.
maria: noted — will keep heading casing as-is. adding reviewers + checklist in PR. thanks :sparkles:
